description: Generic "catch-all" degree types, for approximating degree types not listed in TYPES (eg, "First Degree" to cover any first degree).

field_descriptions.id: A unique identifier for this type of degree
field_descriptions.name: The long name of the degree type, eg "Foundation of Arts"
field_descriptions.hint: An optional hint to be shown alongside the name to users
field_descriptions.suggestion_synonyms: A list of common alternative names that *may* be appropriate for this type
field_descriptions.match_synonyms: A list of common alternative names that are equivalent to this type. An answer matching a match synonym can be safely matched to this type.
field_descriptions.qualification: The ID of the qualification level of this degree (see [`DfE::ReferenceData::Qualifications::QUALIFICATIONS`](https://github.com/DFE-Digital/dfe-reference-data/blob/main/docs/lists_qualifications.md)
field_descriptions.dttp_id: The ID used for this qualification in DQT
field_descriptions.hesa_itt_code: The HESA DEGTYPE code for this degree type (see [DEGTYPE](https://www.hesa.ac.uk/collection/c22053/e/degtype) documentation)
field_descriptions.comment: Any extra comment or description for the field
field_descriptions.generic: If present and true, indicates this is a generic option for degree types not otherwise covered
field_descriptions.unknown: If present and true, indicates that this indicates a degree we do not have type information about

records.name: Higher degree or equivalent
records.hint: Including level 7, level 8, masters, postgraduate certificates and diplomas

records.name: Degree equivalent
records.hint: Including level 6 qualifications, graduate certificates and diplomas, degree apprenticeships and ordinary degrees
